newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Fernandez aide favors sale of Argentine state bank.
newsitem.headline: Fernandez aide favors sale of Argentine state bank.

text.p: Economy Minister Roque Fernandez's chief aide said on Monday that he personally favored the privatization of Banco Nacion, Argentina's largest bank in deposits and second in loans.
"It's a political question. If you ask my opinion, I am in favor of privatizing it, but I think you need a law for that," the official, Carlos Rodriguez, told reporters.
Talk of selling Banco Nacion began in May after a government-sponsored study by former New York Federal Reserve chairman Gerald Corrigan recommended its sale.

Fernandez's predecessor, Domingo Cavallo, had supported the early sale of Nacion and Banco de la Provincia de Buenos Aires -- second in deposits and third in loans -- in keeping with the government's insistence that provinces sell off their state banks. But Cavallo backpedaled after President Carlos Menem came out against such a privatization.
Rodriguez said he was less supportive of selling off the state home-loan bank Banco Hipotecario, since it does not compete with private financial institutions.
